examples.sentence: その時、初めて人を見ました。

previous.explanation_en: 時 (とき) means a time or occasion: a point or period treated as when something happens. It is a Japanese noun and can be modified to identify which time, as in その時 (that time).

parts.contribution_en: The whole word refers to a time or occasion when something happens.

requests.reason: The part gloss repeats the definition, and その時 is a passage-adjacent example displayed separately. Requested change: Remove the redundant whole-word part gloss. Preserve the independent time/occasion meaning; a minimal generic illustration such as その時 is allowed if useful and is not inherently passage-bound.
